ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) field with a low global contrast ratio; high-intensity pixels (white) are estimated at <10% of the surface area, localized to superficial scratches and barnacle clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark grey/black pigmentation across both lobes. Focal high-contrast white pixel clusters are mapped to the distal tips. Extensive light-grey linear and curvilinear mottling is mapped across the central and right-lobe regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central notch with an estimated interior angle of 60-70 degrees and significant pixel-depth relative to the horizontal fluke axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration profile along the entire trailing edge boundary; includes multiple macro-level indentations and jagged peaks particularly prominent on the medial sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading-edge sweep tapering into sharp, narrow distal tips; trailing edge follows a complex, jagged concave-to-convex transition towards the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (barnacles) located at the extreme left and right distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of light-colored, multi-directional linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) observed across the ventral surface, with higher density on the right lobe and near the central notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy irregular chipping and jagged erosion of the trailing edge contour; significant calcified clusters at lobe tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique circular/rosette-shaped scar pattern visible on the mid-left lobe; prominent vertical parallel rake marks near the base of the median notch.
